name: Gold Coast

queries.query: Gold Coast Queensland official cadastral parcel map API property boundaries Queensland Government
queries.result: Found the official Queensland Government Department of Resources PlanningCadastre/LandParcelPropertyFramework ArcGIS REST service and its Cadastral parcels layer. The layer is a polygon DCDB parcel service with public JSON/GeoJSON query support.

queries.query: Gold Coast Queensland Government cadastral lots property boundaries map DCDB official Australian English
queries.result: The same first-party Queensland Government DCDB/QSCF service was identified; Australian English is the local discovery language. Search results also identified the Gold Coast-specific ArcGIS view service, which returned a bounded parcel response.

officialSources.operator: Queensland Government Department of Resources / Gold Coast cadastral ArcGIS view
officialSources.evidence: Public FeatureServer layer named ADM_BND_CADASTRE; polygon geometry; DCDB description; query operation and GeoJSON supported.
Official Cadastral parcels layer describes the DCDB as Queensland property-boundary representation, updated nightly, with polygon geometry and public JSON/GeoJSON query support.
Official access guidance says cadastral data is available through Queensland Globe, downloads and live web map services.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Verified-TLS layer metadata retrieved; polygon layer, OBJECTID, LOTPLAN, GlobalID and other fields exposed. Only safe identity fields were requested subsequently.
Bounded anonymous ID-only probe returned three records; property-name field was requested for route inspection but is not retained.

Exact WUP point queried without shifting coordinates; three intersecting polygon features returned with LOTPLAN identities and GeoJSON geometry. ArcGIS request order was longitude,latitude while the preserved WUP point remains latitude,longitude.
A deliberately latitude,longitude request-order probe returned zero features; this was diagnosed as ArcGIS x,y order and is not treated as absence evidence.

sourceIdentity.crs: EPSG:4326 returned by outSR=4326; layer metadata also exposes service-native CRS

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Gold Coast cadastral ArcGIS view; underlying Queensland DCDB/QSCF documentation describes statewide cadastral coverage.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Public Gold Coast FeatureServer layer and exact-point parcel response verified. Statewide scope is documented by the Queensland Government service, but this attempt did not independently sample the whole city.
coverageAssessment.targetPointHitInterpretation: Exact preserved WUP point intersected three returned parcel polygons; this is local point evidence only, not a citywide completeness claim.

remainingUncertainty: The Gold Coast view exposes additional source fields and may represent strata/building-unit parcels at the exact WUP point. Only LOTPLAN and geometry were retained. No citywide sampling, adapter qualification, or legal-boundary validation was performed.
nextStep: Serial reviewer should independently qualify layer scope, LOTPLAN identity semantics, CRS handling, pagination/extent behaviour, and safe filtering before any runtime adapter admission.
